# btsea -- one row per battle, naval totals.
#
# Replaces balance_btsea_slots_effects.txt, which spelled out 4,001 numbered
# slots so that a row could be addressed without an array index. A global
# variable map is keyed by a runtime number, so the index the language was
# missing is available after all: the row counter is the key and each column is
# its own map. The bucket walk, the slot ceiling and the generated file all go.
#
# Read from the save under `variables.map_data`, one container per column:
#
#     map_data={ { name="btsea_b"
#                  list={ { key={ type=value identity=<row * 100000> }
#                           value={ ... } } ... } } }
#
# Keys are the row number and come back in no particular order -- sort by key.
# Numbers carry the usual x100000 scale. Rows are paired across columns by key,
# so column A's key 7 and column B's key 7 are the same row.
#
# Columns (9), each a map of its own:
#     b        <- global_var:battle_count
#     w0       <- global_var:bcw6
#     w1       <- global_var:bcw7
#     w2       <- global_var:bcw8
#     w3       <- global_var:bcw9
#     l0       <- global_var:bcl6
#     l1       <- global_var:bcl7
#     l2       <- global_var:bcl8
#     l3       <- global_var:bcl9
#
# global_var:btsea_count is still the row count and still the last key written.

btsea_increment_and_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = btsea_count } }
		set_global_variable = { name = btsea_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = btsea_count add = 1 }

	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = btsea_b key = global_var:btsea_count value = global_var:battle_count }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = btsea_w0 key = global_var:btsea_count value = global_var:bcw6 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = btsea_w1 key = global_var:btsea_count value = global_var:bcw7 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = btsea_w2 key = global_var:btsea_count value = global_var:bcw8 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = btsea_w3 key = global_var:btsea_count value = global_var:bcw9 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = btsea_l0 key = global_var:btsea_count value = global_var:bcl6 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = btsea_l1 key = global_var:btsea_count value = global_var:bcl7 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = btsea_l2 key = global_var:btsea_count value = global_var:bcl8 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = btsea_l3 key = global_var:btsea_count value = global_var:bcl9 }
}
